transactions_type_direction.name: transactions_type_direction
transactions_type_direction.value:
("transactions"."transaction_type" in ('purchase','fee','investment','cash_withdrawal') and "transactions"."direction" = 'debit')
        or ("transactions"."transaction_type" in ('income','refund','reversal') and "transactions"."direction" = 'credit')
        or "transactions"."transaction_type" in ('internal_transfer','card_settlement','other')
